jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in India.

This role focuses on building and operating the foundational platform that enables scalable, secure, and production-ready AI capabilities.

You will develop platform services, APIs, SDKs, and pipelines supporting machine learning and large language model development.

The position combines AI/ML engineering with MLOps, cloud infrastructure, automation, and platform reliability.

You will help turn experimentation and development workflows into robust production systems, including retrieval and vector-based applications.

The role also involves deploying models with autoscaling, runtime monitoring, and standardized infrastructure provisioning.

You will contribute to secure and compliant AI environments while collaborating with governance and technical stakeholders.

This is a 100% remote, 12-month contract opportunity for professionals based in India.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, and maintain platform services, APIs, and SDK components that support machine learning and LLM development.
Build and operate ML and LLM pipelines covering data ingestion, feature preparation, training, and related development workflows.
Integrate AI workflows into production-ready pipelines, including document retrieval systems and vector databases.
Develop orchestration components to support reasoning workflows and memory stores.
Deploy predictive and machine learning models into scalable serving environments with autoscaling capabilities.
Implement runtime monitoring and operational practices to maintain reliable AI services.
Standardize and automate environment creation using infrastructure-as-code modules.
Implement CI/CD practices that support efficient and repeatable deployment workflows.
Apply appropriate security and compliance controls in collaboration with governance teams.
Contribute to the reliability, scalability, and maintainability of the overall AI platform.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent professional experience.
2–4 years of experience in AI/ML, MLOps, platform engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Working knowledge of major cloud service platforms and cloud-based infrastructure.
Practical experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD pipelines.
Proficiency in at least one programming language and familiarity with machine learning frameworks.
Understanding of machine learning and large language model development workflows.
Experience working with production-oriented AI/ML systems, pipelines, or platform services.
Familiarity with retrieval workflows, vector databases, model serving, or AI orchestration is beneficial.
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with an ability to work across application and infrastructure layers.
Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment and communicate clearly with technical and cross-functional stakeholders.

Benefits

100% remote work from anywhere in India.
12-month contract opportunity.
Opportunity to work on scalable AI and LLM platform infrastructure.
Hands-on exposure to cloud services, MLOps, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and machine learning frameworks.
Opportunity to contribute to production-grade AI systems, including model serving, retrieval, vector databases, and orchestration.
Experience working on security, compliance, scalability, and platform reliability challenges

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer — AI Data Trainer

About The Role

What if your technical expertise could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI systems reason, plan, and solve problems? We're looking for Machine Learning Engineers to help train cutting-edge AI models by demonstrating how expert minds think through complex technical challenges — step by step.

This isn't prompt engineering or basic annotation. You'll be creating the gold-standard reasoning traces that teach AI models how to strategize, use tools effectively, and reach reliable conclusions in real-world environments. Your work will have a direct, measurable impact on the next generation of AI.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role designed for senior technical professionals who can commit anywhere from 10 to 40 hours per week.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Construct precise, structured reasoning logs that walk through sophisticated technical problems from start to finish
Document sequential decision-making and strategic planning workflows that reflect genuine expert thinking
Demonstrate proficient tool selection and use across complex, multi-step technical scenarios
Generate high-quality training datasets that show AI models what reliable, rigorous problem-solving looks like
Review and critically evaluate AI-generated reasoning steps — identifying gaps, errors, and opportunities for improvement
Work independently and asynchronously on task-based assignments at your own pace

Who You Are

Experienced professional with a strong background in Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline
Exceptional at breaking down complex logical processes and articulating them clearly in writing
A structured, methodical thinker who naturally documents their reasoning — not just their conclusions
Sharp critical eye — you can audit AI-generated reasoning and spot where it goes wrong
Self-directed and reliable when working independently without close supervision
Holds a Master's Degree or PhD in a relevant technical field

Nice to Have

Prior experience with data annotation, data quality evaluation, or AI/ML evaluation pipelines
Familiarity with LLM behavior, RLHF, or AI alignment concepts
Background in technical writing, research documentation, or systems design
Experience working with AI tools, APIs, or coding assistants in a professional context

Why Join Us

Work directly alongside leading AI research labs on projects shaping the frontier of AI
Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
Freelance autonomy with the depth and substance of high-impact technical work
Gain rare, behind-the-scenes exposure to how state-of-the-art LLMs are trained and evaluated
Contribute to AI systems that will influence how technology reasons and solves problems at scale
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.title: Software Engineer — AI Code Ranking
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your years of software engineering experience could directly shape how AI writes code for millions of developers? We're looking for Software Engineers in Bangalore to evaluate, rank, and refine AI-generated code — helping the next generation of coding assistants produce solutions that are correct, efficient, idiomatic, and production-ready.

Your deep understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and real-world engineering trade-offs is exactly what AI models need to get better. This isn't about writing boilerplate — it's about applying expert judgment to push the boundaries of what AI can do with code.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for experienced developers who want meaningful, high-impact work on their own schedule.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Review and rank AI-generated code solutions across multiple programming languages and problem domains
Evaluate code for correctness, efficiency, readability, maintainability, and adherence to best practices
Identify bugs, anti-patterns, security issues, and performance bottlenecks in AI-generated outputs
Write detailed, structured feedback explaining why one solution is better than another
Refine and improve AI-generated code to meet production-level engineering standards
Provide preference rankings that help AI models learn what "good code" actually looks like
Work independently and asynchronously — fully on your own schedule

Who You Are

Software engineer with 3+ years of professional development experience
Proficient in one or more major programming languages (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, Rust)
Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and computational complexity
Deep understanding of software design principles, clean code practices, and engineering trade-offs
Experienced with code review — you know how to assess quality and articulate why something works or doesn't
Clear, concise written communicator who can explain technical decisions effectively
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently without supervision

Nice to Have

Experience across multiple languages, frameworks, or tech stacks
Background in systems design, distributed systems, or backend architecture
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)
Prior experience with code evaluation, technical mentoring, or open-source contribution
Knowledge of security best practices and performance optimization
Experience in competitive programming or technical interviewing

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Directly influence how AI coding assistants learn to write better software
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, task-based work
Leverage your hard-earned engineering expertise in a new, high-impact way
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch
Join a global community of top-tier engineers shaping the future of AI-assisted development

jobs.title: Storage AI Engineer
jobs.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description

In the HPE Hybrid Cloud
, we lead the innovation agenda and technology roadmap for all of HPE. This includes managing the design, development, and product portfolio of our next-generation cloud platform, Green Lake. Working with customers, we help them reimagine their information technology needs to deliver a simple, consumable solution that helps them drive their business results. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Storage AI Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and safety of our AI-powered products. The ideal candidate has a strong testing mindset, experience with software quality processes, and a passion for evaluating AI systems, including large language models (LLMs), recommendation systems, and intelligent automation features.

As a QA Engineer on our AI product team, you will design and execute testing strategies for both traditional software features and AI-specific behaviors such as model accuracy, hallucination detection, prompt reliability, safety, bias, performance, and user trust. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to validate product quality from concept to production.

This role is ideal for engineers with strong software development fundamentals and a passion for Generative AI technologies.

What You’ll Do

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and execute test plans for AI-driven products and features
Evaluate model behavior across real-world scenarios, edge cases, and adversarial inputs
Test prompt flows, agent behaviors, recommendations, summarization, search, classification, and generative outputs
Identify and document issues related to hallucinations, inaccurate outputs, bias, unsafe content, latency, and poor user experience
Build automated test frameworks for regression testing and continuous quality assurance
Conduct manual exploratory testing for new AI features and workflows
Create evaluation metrics and quality rubrics for AI product performance
Collaborate with ML engineers and product teams to define success criteria for AI features
Monitor production issues, analyze root causes, and drive quality improvements
Maintain test documentation, defect tracking, and reporting to stakeholders
Partner with cross-functional teams to improve product quality and release readiness

Required Skills

What You Need to Bring

2-4 years of software QA, quality engineering, or related roles
Basic understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, and RAG.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, and cloud environments.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to learn and work with emerging AI technologies.
Strong understanding of QA methodologies, testing lifecycle, and defect management
Experience with test case design, exploratory testing, and regression testing
Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Postman, or similar
Familiarity with API testing, DB and backend validation
Ability to think critically about edge cases and user behavior
Excellent communication and documentation skills
Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar

Preferred Qualifications

Experience testing AI, ML, or GenAI applications
Knowledge of LLM evaluation techniques, prompt testing, RAG systems, or model benchmarking
Familiarity with Python, JavaScript, or automation scripting
Understanding of metrics such as precision, recall, latency, user satisfaction, and error rates
AI observability and evaluation tools.

Accessibility

HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

Our goal is to be one global team that is representative of our customers, in an inclusive environment where we can continue to innovate and grow together.
